cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: I Know How to Fix Us
cards.instruction: Perform confidence about repairing the relationship while improvising every step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're on stage two of repairing yesterday's shouting match. Choose a biscuit; I've taken charge of getting us talking again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What was stage one? I only came back for my coat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Getting you to ask about the process. Your participation is approved.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You haven't got a process. You're inventing this around whatever I say.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good honesty. I'm authorizing that as stage three. Put the coat down and tell me the next thing; we're making excellent progress.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 takes charge of repair stages, A3 retrospectively approves B question as participation and A5 authorizes criticism as a new stage, preserving authority through visible improvisation.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 missing-stage/coat purpose forces A3 retrospective explanation; B4 invention accusation becomes A5 stage three and a request to stay talking.

relationship.evidence: B2 came for a coat rather than a program and B4 sees the method being invented, giving credible resistance to A confidence.

heightening.evidence: B4 exact diagnosis causes A5 another invented stage that treats honesty as progress and uses the coat to keep the exchange going.
